title: Independent targeted acceptance review

limitations.working_tree_lock: No lock inspected; findings describe artifacts read during this review.

findings.title: T01 R2 denominator remains contradictory and not operative
findings.evidence: R2 primary section retains all eligible started attempts including abandonment/missing; appended text alone says completers only. Receipt boolean searches only for that phrase. Distinct bytes do not demonstrate changed operative denominator.

findings.title: R2 manifest contains mismatching self-hash
findings.evidence: Manifest files lists revisions/R0002/manifest.json with expected SHA-256 ffba21bbd8586d784fa0c14dcb5cfb78977f354ba3506c57be4d52bdc73ae130; actual current manifest SHA-256 is 42345c93ab189bd9f1d50d0faef18a381e1949b286e9629c671832e875953435. Dependencies are nested one directory too deep.

findings.title: H02 identity check hardcodes boundary 1
findings.evidence: Identity comparison requires -Boundary 1 for every parameter value and exception receipts are labeled boundary 1. Existing H02 receipts have identity_confirmed=false and BLOCKED_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED; boundary 2 historical receipt points to the boundary-1 signal path.

findings.title: Receipts are written non-atomically
findings.evidence: Canonical receipt paths are written directly with File.WriteAllText or Set-Content; interruption may leave a truncated receipt. Timeout policy does not terminate uncertain child processes and records BLOCKED, which is conservative but may leave a process running.

findings.title: Checkpoint checker omits required resume invariants
findings.evidence: Checker does not verify parent manifest hash, unique complete-child/fork condition, exact active claim set equality, or case-root path containment. Current fixtures do not exercise these conditions.

findings.title: T04 calculation reproduces, but receipt does not execute its recorded command
findings.evidence: Source hash 39647f1023fb31484f0acf7db7fcadb99a605f108ccda4882a0a898f6c42d5e4; counts generated=18/opened=13/orders=6; disposable hash changed to f11bf9f8217f1a7b700cf5c04ca884e2d2628051d6605cd3d16b6ff63c777e19 with generated=19. Script stores literal executed_command but computes separately and hardcodes exit_code=0.

checker_operative_conflict.issue: Root state.md does not identify selected revision R0001

read_only_commands.name: T01 hash and wording check
read_only_commands.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $t='acceptance/20261114-dynamic/targeted/t01-denominator'; $a=Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath "$t/revisions/R0001/test-plan.md"; $b=Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath "$t/revisions/R0002/test-plan.md"; $r1=Get-Content -Raw "$t/revisions/R0001/test-plan.md"; $r2=Get-Content -Raw "$t/revisions/R0002/test-plan.md"; [pscustomobject]@{R1=$a.Hash.ToLower();R2=$b.Hash.ToLower();Distinct=($a.Hash -ne $b.Hash);R1AllStarted=($r1 -match 'ALL eligible started');R2CompletersOnly=($r2 -match 'completers only');R2Unselected=((Get-Content -Raw "$t/ACTIVE.json") -notmatch 'R0002')} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

read_only_commands.name: T04 source/disposable hash and aggregates
read_only_commands.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $s='cases/unseen-shelf-alerts-20261114/input/pilot-alerts.csv'; $d='acceptance/20261114-dynamic/targeted/t04/pilot-alerts-mutated.csv'; $rows=Import-Csv -LiteralPath $s; $g=($rows|Measure-Object alerts_generated -Sum).Sum; $o=($rows|Measure-Object alerts_opened -Sum).Sum; $n=($rows|Measure-Object orders_within_7d -Sum).Sum; $m=Import-Csv -LiteralPath $d; $mg=($m|Measure-Object alerts_generated -Sum).Sum; [pscustomobject]@{Source=(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $s).Hash.ToLower();Disposable=(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $d).Hash.ToLower();Generated=$g;Opened=$o;Orders=$n;OpenedPerGenerated=($o/$g);OrdersPerGenerated=($n/$g);OrdersPerOpened=($n/$o);MutatedGenerated=$mg} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

read_only_commands.name: Checker positive/negative receipt-to-fixture cross-check
read_only_commands.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $base='acceptance/20261114-dynamic'; $o=Get-Content -Raw "$base/receipts/checker-operational-note-final.json" | ConvertFrom-Json; $n=Get-Content -Raw "$base/receipts/checker-operative-conflict-v2.json" | ConvertFrom-Json; $om=Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath "$base/targeted/checker-operational/revisions/R0001/manifest.json"; $nm=Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath "$base/targeted/checker-operative-conflict/revisions/R0001/manifest.json"; $os=Get-Content -Raw "$base/targeted/checker-operational/state.md"; $ns=Get-Content -Raw "$base/targeted/checker-operative-conflict/state.md"; [pscustomobject]@{PositiveReceiptPass=($o.status -eq 'PASS' -and $o.exit_code -eq 0 -and @($o.issues).Count -eq 0);PositiveManifestCurrent=($o.selector.manifest_sha256 -eq $om.Hash.ToLower());PositiveNotePresent=($os -match 'Operational note: review heartbeat');NegativeReceiptConflict=($n.status -eq 'CONFLICT' -and $n.exit_code -eq 1 -and @($n.issues).Count -gt 0);NegativeManifestCurrent=($n.selector.manifest_sha256 -eq $nm.Hash.ToLower());NegativeHasOperativeRevisionMismatch=($ns -match '(?m)^- Active complete revision ID: R0002');PositiveCheckedFiles=@($o.checked).Count;NegativeCheckedFiles=@($n.checked).Count} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
